French Quarter & CBD Towers.name: French Quarter & CBD Towers
French Quarter & CBD Towers.description: Historic Quarter grid beside the Poydras Street high-rise core, where hospitality-driven ground floor demand meets limited entitled supply.

BioDistrict & University Medical.name: BioDistrict & University Medical
BioDistrict & University Medical.description: University Medical Center and the VA hospital anchoring a bioscience district with institutional expansion and supporting multifamily.

Warehouse & Arts District.name: Warehouse & Arts District
Warehouse & Arts District.description: Julia Row galleries and converted cotton warehouses carrying condo conversions and hotel-adjacent adaptive reuse.

Bywater & St. Claude Corridor.name: Bywater & St. Claude Corridor
Bywater & St. Claude Corridor.description: Shotgun-grid neighbourhood along the St. Claude arts corridor with sustained small-scale renovation permitting.

Marigny & Frenchmen Street.name: Marigny & Frenchmen Street
Marigny & Frenchmen Street.description: Music-venue economy around Frenchmen Street with Creole-cottage stock and short-term-rental policy shaping values.

Magazine Street Retail Corridor.name: Magazine Street Retail Corridor
Magazine Street Retail Corridor.description: Six miles of independent retail and antiques through the Garden District edge, with historic-district review constraining change.

Audubon & Riverbend.name: Audubon & Riverbend
Audubon & Riverbend.description: Zoo- and university-adjacent residential stock with the deepest-demand single-family market in Orleans Parish.

Carrollton & Oak Street.name: Carrollton & Oak Street
Carrollton & Oak Street.description: Streetcar-served neighbourhood commercial node with levee-adjacent housing and steady infill renovation.

City Park & Bayou St. John.name: City Park & Bayou St. John
City Park & Bayou St. John.description: Park-edge bungalow stock beside the bayou waterway, drawing renovation capital from the museum and festival economy.

Tulane-Canal Corridor.name: Tulane-Canal Corridor
Tulane-Canal Corridor.description: Hospital-and-streetcar spine toward Carrollton Avenue with older multifamily stock and clinic-driven demand.

Lakeview & Lakeshore.name: Lakeview & Lakeshore
Lakeview & Lakeshore.description: Post-Katrina rebuilt lakefront neighbourhoods behind the outfall canals, with elevated new construction dominating permits.

Gentilly & Dillard.name: Gentilly & Dillard
Gentilly & Dillard.description: Mid-century tract housing between the university campuses and the Industrial Canal with gradual redevelopment interest.

New Orleans East I-10 Corridor.name: New Orleans East I-10 Corridor
New Orleans East I-10 Corridor.description: Read Boulevard and I-10 service-road retail with the Michoud industrial reserve driving long-run logistics growth.

Village de l'Est & Lake Forest.name: Village de l'Est & Lake Forest
Village de l'Est & Lake Forest.description: Vietnamese-American commercial nodes along Alcee Fortier and Chef Menteur with large-lot residential recovery.

Algiers Point.name: Algiers Point
Algiers Point.description: Ferry-connected historic district across from the Quarter with Victorian stock and skyline-view demand.

English Turn & Tall Timbers.name: English Turn & Tall Timbers
English Turn & Tall Timbers.description: Golf-course and subdivision growth downriver on the West Bank with parish-edge land supply.

Metairie Causeway Boulevard Retail.name: Metairie Causeway Boulevard Retail
Metairie Causeway Boulevard Retail.description: Jefferson Parish's dominant strip-retail and office corridor running Lakeside Shopping Center to the lakefront.

Kenner Esplanade & Airport District.name: Kenner Esplanade & Airport District
Kenner Esplanade & Airport District.description: Esplanade mall district and Louis Armstrong International adjacency with hospitality and logistics tenancy.

Harahan & River Ridge.name: Harahan & River Ridge
Harahan & River Ridge.description: River-bend single-family suburbs of East-Bank Jefferson with stable owner-occupant demand and Old Jefferson retail edges.

Chalmette Refinery Corridor.name: Chalmette Refinery Corridor
Chalmette Refinery Corridor.description: Refinery-adjacent parish seat with buyout-zone land dynamics and petrochemical payroll underpinning demand.

Arabi & Meraux.name: Arabi & Meraux
Arabi & Meraux.description: River-road communities nearest the Orleans line absorbing first-ring spillover demand from the Bywater.
